description: This file is a shell script that defines and runs tests related to 'git apply' handling submodules, including applying patches with specific options and verifying behaviors.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies a git diff with --ignore-submodules=dirty and tests the failure or success based on argument.

methods.name: apply_3way
methods.description: Applies a git diff with --ignore-submodules=dirty using --3way and tests the failure or success based on argument.
